newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the panhandle area late Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 10,700 slaughter steers and 5,400 heifers; 40,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,800 formulated and 400 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 72.00. Pen
select and choice 2-4 1100 lbs including heiferettes 65.00.
Wk to Date: 40,400 Week Ago: 196,000 Year Ago: 96,900
